artworks.title: Bacchanal with a Wine Vat
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Bacchanalian scene with classical figures and a grapevine. It depicts a group of muscular figures engaged in a celebration around a barrel beneath a fruiting grapevine. Various poses are shown, with some figures holding or pouring liquids, while others interact with the grapes on the vine. The artwork features detailed anatomical rendering of the figures, intricate design of foliage and textures of materials like the wood of the barrel and the stone floor. Playful putti contribute to the lively and festive atmosphere. The composition is dense and dynamic, capturing the spirit of revelry and indulgence.

artworks.title: Battle of the Sea Gods [left half]
artworks.description: This print is a depiction of mythological creatures and muscular humans engaged in combat amidst swirling waves. On the left are two men riding horses with fins and the tails of fish. The men both have leaf-like hair and curved, pointed ears. The man on the right wears a billowing cloak and holds a long rod towards the other man. The man on the left is nude and holds a bundle of fish above his head. On the far left, another nude man rides a creature with fins, a tail, and the head of a dog, its mouth wide open. This man holds a long staff and looks off towards the left. A nude woman stands behind him on the creature, holding a bunch of cloth in her right hand and a small sign in her left hand. She is thin, with long, curling hair and a wrinkled face, and she looks to the right towards the two fighting men. In the background are tall reeds or grass, a statue of a man holding a trident, and a distant city on a hill.

artworks.title: Battle of the Sea Gods [right half]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures engaged in a river scene. The image depicts a group of mythological figures that appear to be part human and part aquatic creature, possibly mermen or sirens, in a lively scene near water. Some figures are holding instruments, and there are ornamental aquatic elements like fish scales and a horse-like creature emerging from the water. The detailed artwork suggests an etching or engraving technique, delivering a narrative of mythical origin with complex interactions. The style is reminiscent of the Renaissance period, capturing movement and emotion through detailed line work.

artworks.title: Descent into Limbo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper (by Gian Marco Cavalli?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an archway guarded by fantastical creatures and figures. The scene features an architectural structure resembling an ancient archway in a ruinous state, with cracked surfaces and irregular stone blocks. Near the base of the arch, a figure steps onto a platform surrounded by debris and broken pillars. In the background, mythical creatures with wings and grotesque features lurk. The composition incorporates intricate line work and shading reminiscent of Renaissance engravings and drawings.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving featuring two figures. One figure is a man carrying a goat-like creature with human features over his shoulder. The man has a bearded, muscular face with short, wavy hair and well-defined muscles. Both figures are nude, with the man wearing a decorative belt. The background consists of leaves, branches, a tree trunk, and intricate line work creating texture and depth. There is an inscription in a stylized font on the left side of the engraving. The scene is depicted in a single color typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Four Dancing Muses
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in flowing garments dancing or moving rhythmically. The figures are depicted with detailed drapery and elegant postures. They are intertwined through their gestures and clothes, creating a sense of unity and harmony within the composition. The drawing is executed with delicate line work, showcasing the play of light and shadow across the figures, giving them a three-dimensional quality. Each figure's garment billows in a natural rhythm, contributing to the overall dynamic yet serene scene captured in the image.

artworks.title: Allegorical Theme: Combat of Animals
artworks.artist: Master of the Beheading of St. John the Baptist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical scene with fantastical creatures. The setting is a rugged natural environment with a nude figure on a rock holding a large reflective disk or shield. The creatures include a lion with dragon-like features and a horse with a serpentine tail, depicted in a dynamic manner interacting with each other. The landscape includes expansive plains and a distant castle, hinting at a classical influence.

artworks.title: Two Children Wearing Helmets
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: The image is a detailed vertical design with mythical creatures, floral motifs, and elaborate decorations. It includes a stylized flaming form at the top, followed by heraldic elements like a shield, axes, and a jousting pole. In the middle, there is an urn or vase shape with fabric and floral patterns, and at the bottom, two reclining mythical figures surrounded by volutes and floral embellishments. The drawing is composed of fine lines and exhibits influences from Renaissance or Baroque art with its opulent decoration and classical motifs.

artworks.title: Nereid Ridden by Two Children
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: This is an elaborate ornamental design featuring a vertical composition with classical elements including urns, acanthus leaves, volutes, cherubs, lion-like figures, and mythological creatures. The top section resembles an ornate vase or candelabrum surrounded by swirling patterns, while the bottom features a central motif of classical figures. The drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance-style decorative designs, characterized by fine line work and symmetrical detail.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saint Anne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with figures in an ornate architectural setting. The center of the image features two seated figures, both depicted in a classical style with drapery cascading over their forms, positioned on a throne-like structure under a domed archway with classical columns. On either side of the central figures are intricate scenes, possibly depicting biblical narratives, with angels hovering above, carrying banners with inscriptions. The background is detailed with various figures, animals, and architectures, suggesting pastoral scenes. The floor in the foreground displays a geometric pattern in perspective, adding to the depth of the composition. The entire drawing demonstrates attention to detail and expertise in rendering texture and perspective.

artworks.title: Satyr Family
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.8 x 10.5 cm (6 1/4 x 4 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. To the left, a figure with the characteristics of a satyr is standing playing a pipe. The figure has pointed ears, curly hair, and is unclothed. To the right, a seated woman holds a slender branch. She has long hair, styled with a head covering, and finely detailed facial features with a calm expression. She wears flowing garments. The background features a rustic landscape with trees, one small mythical creature, and an animal next to a dish. The name "Benedeto Montagna" is inscribed above the woman.

artworks.title: Battle of the Nudes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient battle scene. It depicts numerous nude male figures engaged in hand-to-hand combat in a forested environment. The men are wielding swords and shields, and their bodies are contorted with the tension of the battle. The detailed musculature and expressive poses capture the movement of the scene. The background features dense vegetation with twisted trees and thick foliage. The composition includes overlapping figures creating a sense of chaos and urgency. The style of the drawing has influences from the Renaissance period, focusing on anatomy and dramatic expression.

artworks.title: Fate of an Evil Tongue
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.9 x 20.5 cm (11 3/8 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures engaged in communal activity. The scene features young, cherub-like figures around a central pedestal or plinth, participating in an energetic activity with tools. The background includes architectural elements like arches, columns, and floral motifs, suggesting a classical or ancient ruin setting. A natural scene with trees and foliage is on the right, and in the distance are buildings and towers in a town or city. Additional cherubic figures are scattered on the ground, with one resting. Stone or metalwork decorates the structure, with intricate carvings or inscriptions visible on the facade.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.description: The image features a person in decorative armor standing in a contrapposto pose. The armor has scale-like patterns, a plumed helmet, and greaves. The person has a determined expression, with a clean-shaven face and straight gaze. They hold a spear and a sword. The figure stands under an architectural structure with the words "NICOLETO DAMODENA." The background includes architectural elements, trees, and hills. A subdued mythical creature lies at the person's feet.

artworks.title: Old Woman with a Distaff
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing indoors and engaging in an activity. The person's face is partially obscured, with a possible profile and a focused gaze downward. They are wearing a wrap, a long robe, and shoes. The person holds a spindle and distaff for spinning yarn. In the background, there is a fireplace mantel with a pitcher and dish on the left, and some tools and a picture frame against the wall on the right.

artworks.title: Knight, Death and Devil
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 24.8 x 19 cm (9 3/4 x 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: A man wearing a full suit of armor rides a horse on a narrow path alongside a ghoulish, skeletal creature wrapped in snakes and a goat-headed, horned creature, all set again sheer, rocky outcroppings that nearly fill this vertical engraving. The scene is created with fine, black lines built up in hatching and crosshatching to make deep shadows, and is printed on cream-white paper. The armored man rides toward our left in profile with a long lance resting on his right shoulder, farther from us, and the other hand holding the muscular horse’s reins. The lance extends off both sides of the paper and is wrapped with a fox’s tail near the top. The man’s face is wrinkled with deep-set eyes staring straight ahead. He has a prominent, bumped nose and wide mouth closed in a line, with the corner we can see pulled slightly up. The visor of his helmet is pushed up but his eyes are shielded from the creatures beyond the horse by the flaring sides of his helmet. Armor covers every inch of his body, including his hands and feet, and a long sword hangs at his left hip, closer to us. Spanning the width of the composition, his muscular horse walks with one front and one back leg raised and its chin pulled back, also looking straight ahead. A long-haired dog runs in the same direction between the horse’s feet over a lizard scrambling in the opposite direction. Seen between the armored man’s body and his horse’s head, the ghoulish creature at the side of the dirt path wears a spiky crown entwined with a snake and another serpent winds across his shoulders. The creature looks toward the armored man with round, piercing eyes, a hole where the nose should be, and a nearly toothless, gaping maw. He has a long, lanky beard and hair, and he holds up an hourglass topped with a clock-like dial. This creature also rides a horse, whose head hangs close to the ground. To our right, the goat-headed creature looks toward the armored rider with round eyes and its long snout slightly open to show fangs and teeth. Horns curl down to its shoulders and one long, sharp horn, dotted with spikes at the base, curves up and back over the creature’s face. It holds a double-pronged, spear-like halberd like a walking stick. Immediately beyond the group, rocky outcroppings push into the sky. The branches of barren trees and bushes are outlined against the blank, white sky and their craggy roots poke out of the rock. High on a hill in the deep distance is a castle complex or town. A plaque near a human skull resting on a tree stump in the lower left corner has the date of the print and the artist's monogram. "S. 1513" is followed by a "D" between the long legs of a capital "A."

artworks.title: Landscape with the Cannon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.9 × 32 cm (8 5/8 × 12 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural setting from an elevated angle. It depicts a village with thatched-roof buildings extending into the distance. Towards the center, the village meets a silhouetted city in the far distance. Past the village, there are hills and mountains with thin, linear clouds above. The scene is detailed and illustrated in black and white. Near us, figures in historical attire stand by a cannon, while a tree trunk frames the left side. The image is monochromatic, using shades of brown and gray to capture the scene.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Mocked by a Soldier
artworks.description: The image shows two men in an intricate scene. The man on the right is seated with his hands bound, appearing submissive. He has a pronounced face with a beard and mustache, and hair styled with a crown of thorns. The seated man is muscular and partially covered with a draped cloth. The man on the left is kneeling, holding a stick in his raised right hand and gesturing with his left hand. He has curly hair and a beard. He is dressed in a tunic and a sleeveless outer garment with folds and a textured pattern. Textual elements are present above and below the scene. The background is clear with cloud-like formations suggesting a celestial setting.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 39.3 x 28.4 cm (15 1/2 x 11 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men gathered around a long table. The central figure has an aura-like burst behind his head and is seated with others leaning towards him or gesturing. The men have long hair and beards, and wear long robes. One individual is pouring liquid from a pitcher into a cup, while another leans forward. On the table is a plate with food and a cup. The background shows an arched and vaulted ceiling with a stone or brick walls. The style of the image is monochromatic and engraved.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing showing soldiers or warriors engaged in battle in a forest setting. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses with medieval-style weapons. The scene is detailed with elaborate costumes and armor, showcasing an intricate interaction. In the background, there are a few trees and a light sky. The style of the drawing suggests it may be a historical woodcut.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.description: Thirteen men are portrayed in a woodcut style. They are sitting around a long table. The central figure has long hair, a beard, and a circle above his head. The others have varying facial expressions and wear robes reminiscent of historical or religious attire. Wine glasses and a bowl are on the table. The room has a textured wall with a small window. Under the table, there is a basket with bread and a plate with the year "1523" and "AD" inscribed on it.

artworks.title: The Beast with Two Horns like a Lamb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in the heavens and earth. The scene depicts a figure seated upon a cloud, surrounded by other angelic beings. To the right, a creature with multiple heads, stands prominently. Below, figures clad in robes seem to gather and point towards this creature. The composition includes intricate lines and textures, adding a dramatic quality to the image.

artworks.title: The Madonna on the Crescent
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a woman sitting on a crescent moon holding a child. The woman appears serene with closed eyes and long hair. The child has curly hair and faces upwards. The woman wears draped robes, a veil, and a crown of stars. The crescent moon has an ornate border, and both figures are surrounded by radiating lines. Small stars are scattered in the background. Latin text is at the top, and additional verses are below the figures on a textured paper background.

artworks.title: Joachim's Offering Rejected
artworks.description: This is a drawing of people gathered around a table in a richly decorated room. The scene includes numerous figures standing and sitting around a large table under a large stone archway and an ornate chandelier. The figures are engaged in various activities, some holding objects and others reading a book. The setting is framed by large draped curtains, and the stone walls show signs of age and texture. The lines and shading in the drawing provide texture and depth to the figures, architecture, and textiles.
